commands.isekai_mahou.familiars.fail: Failed: no awakened familiar, already awakened, or unknown form.
commands.isekai_mahou.familiars.reset: Familiar reset (stash items were returned to you).
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.bone_raven.d: Born from those who know death up close: who fall often, and who hunt the already fallen.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.dawn_hare.de: Born from those who care: light, meditation, fair trades and raising animals.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.ember_fox.de: Born from those who settle things in the heat of the moment: fire, powder, forge and road.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.fortune_drak: Born from those who chase glory and gold: fallen bosses, opened chests and high stakes.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.gale_owl.des: Born from those who never sit still: travelers, archers and those who like the view from above.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.rune_wisp.de: Born from those who study: glyphs, bookshelves, enchantments and long meditations.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.shade_cat.de: Born from those who walk in the shadows: light steps, sure strikes and no hurry.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.stone_tortoi: Born from those who dig deep and take a beating: miners, smiths and walking walls.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.tide_otter.d: Born from those who live by the water: fishing, swimming, brewing and taking it easy.
familiars.isekai_mahou.form.verdant_spri: Born from those who plant and raise: harvests, herds and the patience of the forest.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.ambush: Sixth sense: warns of creepers, invisible enemies and anyone coming from behind.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.death_guide: Soul guide: shows the way to your last death and warns of the undead.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.fetch: Fetch: brings nearby dropped items to you and keeps the cold away.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.forage: Forage: when hunger bites, brings you a snack from time to time.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.mana: Spark: out of combat, slowly restores your resource — only up to half.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.mend: Gentle light: light healing out of combat (and, once grown, cures poison).
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.ore: Ore sense: from time to time (or when petted) points at the nearest ore.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.soothe: Soothe: puts out fire, gives back breath underwater and heals very lightly out of combat.
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.treasure: Treasure sense: points at unopened loot chests (and, once grown, monster spawners).
familiars.isekai_mahou.help.watch: Watch: warns you from afar about whoever is hunting you that you haven't seen yet.
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.awakened: A bond is born: %s awakens by your side.
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.death_elsewhe: You fell in another dimension: it can't reach from here.
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.death_trail: You fell %s blocks away, that way.
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.evolved: Your familiar has grown: %s is now %s!
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.need_call: Your familiar must be nearby to open its bag.
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.no_death: There is no death of yours to remember.
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.nothing: Your familiar found nothing around here.
familiars.isekai_mahou.msg.shifted: You changed, and your familiar changed with you: it is now %s.
familiars.isekai_mahou.ritual.need_class: Choose a class first: the familiar is born from who you are.
familiars.isekai_mahou.ritual.need_fire: The incense needs a lit campfire nearby.
familiars.isekai_mahou.ritual.need_level: You are still a mystery even to yourself: reach level %s.
familiars.isekai_mahou.ritual.same: The bond is renewed. %s is still just like you.
familiars.isekai_mahou.spell.no.complex: simple spells only (one stage, no laws, triggers, ultimates or transformations).
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_awakened: Your Familiar was born from how you play. See the Familiar tab in the menu.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_ambush: Your cat sensed an ambush: look for the glowing outline.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_death_gu: Your raven points at danger and at the way to your last death.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_fetch: Your fox brought the dropped items to you.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_forage: Your sprout brought a snack: hunger eases.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_mana: Your wisp restores a little energy out of combat.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_mend: Your hare slowly heals you out of combat.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_ore: Your tortoise smelled ore: follow the sparkle.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_soothe: Your otter took care of you.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_treasure: Your drake smelled treasure: follow the sparkle.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_help_watch: Your owl warned you: the glowing outline is whoever is hunting you.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_incense: Bond Incense: hold right-click near a lit campfire.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_ritual: You can now awaken a Familiar: craft a Bond Incense and burn it near a campfire.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_shifted: Familiars change with their owner: class, race, element and deeds shape the form.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_spell: Your Familiar learned a support spell: it casts it on you by itself when needed.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_spell_cast: Your Familiar used the spell you taught it. It recharges on its own.
hint.isekai_mahou.familiar_stash: Sneak + click the Familiar: opens its bag.
item.isekai_mahou.bond_incense.desc: Hold to burn near a lit campfire: awakens your Familiar.
item.isekai_mahou.bond_incense.desc2: Requires a chosen class and level %s. With a Familiar, renews the bond and its form.
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.drift: It is restless: you are looking more and more like a %s (%s/%s).
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.feat.chest: You open every chest you see
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.feat.death: You have died quite a bit
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.max_stage: Final form. Your bond is complete.
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.name: Give it a name (Enter)
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.none: You haven't awakened a Familiar yet.
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.spell.abou: Teach ONE support spell: the familiar casts it on you by itself, weaker and on a recharge. Only healing, cleansing, protection, light and finding things — it does not fight for you.
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.spell.empt: None of your spells fits. Build a support-only spell in the Grimoire (e.g. Self + Heal, Shield, Light or Detect) and come back.
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.spell.when: Used whenever it recharges, outside cities.
Used when you are on fire or under a bad effect.
Used when you are taking hits.
Used when you are running out of air.
screen.isekai_mahou.familiars.tip: In the world: click it to pet; sneaking opens the bag.
